mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 jobs in a month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS MoM < -100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a significant demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM < -10% and RSAFS QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 1% during a late-cycle expansion.
